visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A shirtless man with short black hair stands in a brightly lit indoor living room, staring at a white smartphone in his hand with a puzzled facial expression. In the background, a man wearing a white t-shirt and grey loose-fitting trousers walks across the frame. The setting includes cream-colored walls, a display shelf holding small stuffed toy animals, and a yellow text overlay at the top. (2) A woman wearing a white graphic t-shirt, short dark shorts, and a beige baseball cap stands centrally in the living room, gesturing defensively with her hands while facing the two men. Behind her is a modern white leather L-shaped sofa and a large cream bean bag. The lighting is bright and even, and various Traditional Chinese captions appear at the bottom of the frame. (3) The scene shifts to a higher-angle view of the living room sofa area. The woman is seated on the white sofa, covered by a tan blanket, holding a black remote control which she then pushes towards a beige bag. A man in a dark t-shirt sits beside her. The background shows a glass-partitioned kitchen area and a television screen reflection. (4) The group of three individuals is seen moving around the sofa, lifting cushions and searching the floor. The shirtless man from the first phase is now seen wearing a black top. The woman has a black jacket draped over her shoulders and carries a black bag. The handheld camera follows their movements as they search the living space frantically.
